title: Collimation with spectral mixing of biased coset preparations

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the spectral mixing algorithm in proof.md Sections 1–6 uses the PCROOT-1 bank and logical collimation in base-bank.md, virtual.md and odd_partition.md with the stated block mixer and finite branch. Its total sequential charged work T is O(2^((288675134594813/250000000000000) sqrt(n))) with exactly this representative and exact growth index 1/2. This guarantee holds on every execution branch jointly with the other resource bounds and unconditional full-secret success probability at least 1-2^(-7) for every allowed source in the fifth claim, including the clean source. All outside constants are absolute.

Its proved malformed fraction is epsilon(n) = 1, valid for all n >= 1 under the spectral-gap coset-preparation model in error_model, including adversarially selected bounded spectra, source coherences within V_s, and conditional product delivery with classical correlations. Every acquired copy may be a malformed delivery satisfying that model. The full-secret success probability is at least 1-2^(-7), jointly with the four branchwise resource guarantees.

structured.error_model: Spectral-gap coset-preparation model. For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, with omega = exp(2 pi i/N), let chi_k = N^(-1/2) sum_y omega^(ky)|y> and phi_k(s) = (|0> + omega^(-ks)|1>)/sqrt(2). Let V_s be the span of the N orthonormal vectors phi_k(s) tensor chi_k. An unheralded malformed delivery may be any density matrix sigma on the usual (n+1)-qubit register supported on V_s, subject to the following bound. Write p(k) for its diagonal in that basis. For every nonzero j modulo N, |sum_k p(k) omega^(jk)| is at most 1/2. A clean delivery is the independent ideal rho_s in the challenge. The supplier may choose kind and state of every delivery knowing N, s, the solver description and all previous measurement outcomes, and may use arbitrary classical randomness and records. Conditional on its choices and private classical record, the chosen copy is fresh in tensor product with all earlier copies and the solver workspace. Correlations between preparations are classical. The supplier cannot access or change a delivered register or access future private algorithm randomness. After an acquisition the solver gets only the register and no herald or spectral weights. The bound covers every allowed supplier with at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed deliveries among the Q acquired, including the clean problem. It is a bound on the fraction of delivered registers, valid for every n >= 1.
